text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now for a Pearl Question. Who in the whole 
world loves local bento the most? —That's 
right, me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Second Pearl Question! Who was it that 
requested local specialty bento boxes at 
the shop? —That's right, it was me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Lastly! Who broke the supplier stereotype 
that 'local ekiben should only be eaten 
locally'? —That's right, me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"To eat a local bento is to understand the 
locality." There really is a "world of 
bentos" like that— Fufu, in the end, we 
connected on a spiritual level.
